title: J.X close: Above all for Truth and Protestant peace — both sides agree on Lord's Supper substance; do not devour each other over words while Rome dances
pass_a_gloss: Partly finally and most of all for the favor both of Truth and of Protestant Peace, lest, just as either part of the Evangelicals agrees in the matter and substance of the Truth as to the Article on the Holy Supper (which will be clear to the eye below), so they be pulled apart by quarrels about words found in either Augsburg Confession and amid pontifical dances bite one another, to be consumed by one another.
pass_b_english: Finally — and most of all — it was for Truth and for Protestant peace.
Both Evangelical sides already agree in the matter and substance of the truth on the article of the Lord's Supper (that will be plain below).
They must not be torn apart by fights over words in either Augsburg Confession, and bite one another to pieces while Rome dances.
source_text: Partim denique & maxime omnium in gratiam & Veritatis & Pacis Protestanticae, ne, quemadmodum Evangelicorum utraque pars in re & substantia Veritatis, quoad Articulum de Sacra Coena, consentit, (id quod infra ad oculum patebit) ita litigiis de verbis, in alterutra Confessione Augustana repertis, distrahantur & inter tripudia Pontificia mordeant se mutuo, a se mutuo consumendi.

lemmas.gloss: in the matter and substance of the Truth
